quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are in or near a school zone. Watch for children and drive at the posted speed limit.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. They alert drivers to watch for bicycles and other traffic that may cross the road.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic is coming from both directions. Be ready for vehicles coming toward you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign warns that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: This symbol is used for:
questions.explanation: A bright orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it moves slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn carriages. It looks orange during the day and red at night.

questions.question: When you see this sign, it means:

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: This chevron sign points in the direction the road curves. In this case, it shows a sharp left curve. You may see several of these signs along a curve.

questions.question: This sign is used to prevent:

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is one-way. Do not enter from your current direction.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers turning left on a green light to yield to oncoming traffic. You may turn left when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns you of a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downgrade is coming. Check your brakes.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop, whether there's a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always give pedestrians the right of way. Stay alert for pedestrians at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a pedestrian crosswalk is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds in a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road will be slippery when wet. Slow down.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of work zones. Stay alert for unexpected driving conditions. A flagger is coming up, and you must follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on vehicles that travel slowly.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the maximum speed allowed on that road. In rain, snow, ice, or bad conditions, drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign mean?

options.text: It warns you about conditions on or near the road.
It helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
It tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
It tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: It warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background. They alert you to conditions on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at a sharp angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at a sharp angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to immediate conditions ahead. This sign warns you to slow down and prepare for an abrupt change in direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes especially slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and warn you about upcoming hazardous conditions. This sign warns that the road ahead curves right and then left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic must yield to oncoming traffic even when the light is green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic must yield to oncoming traffic even when the light is green.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic light to tell drivers that left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way and must wait for oncoming traffic to pass.

questions.question: You see this sign for a railroad crossing with no signal. What should you do?

options.text: Keep a steady speed while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with this sign, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be prepared to stop. Never try to drive faster than a train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and warn you about upcoming hazardous conditions. This sign tells you a school zone is ahead and you should slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road, entrance, or exit. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Do not drive this direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming situations. This sign warns that a side road will intersect ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane is ending. Traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending. Traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells drivers that one lane is ending and they need to merge left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. They prepare drivers for road hazards ahead. This sign tells drivers a lane is ending and to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions you might not see right away. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid crashes and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic going the same direction will soon merge into one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left then right.
The road curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road will curve right first, then curve left. Adjust your speed to drive safely through these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a sharp right turn is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light is allowed if it is safe.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead is one-way only.
Only one car can use the bridge at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that an upcoming bridge is too narrow to safely pass a truck. Be careful.

questions.question: What type of sign has this shape and color?
questions.explanation: This pennant shape is only used for no passing zone signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you to be careful when the road is wet because it may be slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road surface is slippery when it rains or gets wet.

questions.question: What do orange background signs mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs are only used for construction and maintenance warnings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let the merging traffic in safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of two-way traffic ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests and use paddles and red flags to direct traffic through construction zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and roadways where you cannot enter. You may see it if you try to go the wrong way on an expressway ramp.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two-way traffic is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you are leaving a divided roadway and entering a two-way highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking on the road ahead.
Construction workers are on the road ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Drive carefully and watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that an intersection is coming. Be ready for traffic and prepare to turn or stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.
The road ahead has several curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed, do not brake suddenly, and keep more distance from the car ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign show?

options.text: The height from the road to a bridge or overpass.
The tallest vehicle allowed in this state.
The widest vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The height from the road to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of low clearance. It shows how much space is between the road and the bottom of a bridge or overpass (in this case, 12 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: This sign shape and color is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: Triangle-shaped signs mean yield. Slow down and check for traffic. Stop if necessary. If you stop, do so at a marked stop line.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves right and then left. Slow down to safely drive through these curves.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangle-shaped sign is a yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Give the right-of-way to pedestrians and oncoming cars. Stop only if needed.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Unless it is safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must follow. This sign means do not pass other vehicles at all in this area.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Keep your regular speed.
Look and listen. Be ready to stop if needed.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look and listen. Be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, look both ways, listen for trains, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you cross the tracks.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Keep driving at the same speed.
Speed up to avoid traffic congestion.
Change lanes (if safe) to make room for traffic entering.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes (if safe) to make room for traffic entering.
questions.explanation: On a road with two or more lanes, make room for vehicles entering. If the next lane is empty, move over one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails are ahead and to the right.
A hotel is ahead and to the right.
A hospital is ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A hospital is ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that hospital emergency services are located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means "stop."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot continue driving in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions coming up ahead. This sign warns you to get ready for traffic merging safely from the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the divided highway ends ahead. Be ready to change lanes or shift your position.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions coming up. This sign warns you about an upcoming winding road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A sharp turn is ahead—slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: A sharp turn is ahead—slow down.
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you about a sharp turn ahead and tells you to reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
Because of roadwork ahead, take a detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead turns sharply.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead turns sharply.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead turns at a sharp angle (in this case, to the right). Slow down before reaching such a sharp curve, just as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. An island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must stay to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. It is unsafe and against the law to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. Regulation signs tell drivers what traffic rules they must follow. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and cars crossing.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and cars crossing.
questions.explanation: Any eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely and look for pedestrians and crossing traffic. Wait until the intersection is clear before going forward.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: Can pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
Can pass if you know the road ahead.

questions.explanation: Regulation signs are white and rectangular with black text. You must follow the rules on these signs. Where this sign is posted, passing is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is near.
Always stop completely at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp right turn ahead.
You can turn right only on a green arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp right turn ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs have a yellow or yellow-green background. These signs alert you to upcoming conditions like curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a crossroad is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what traffic laws to follow. This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed when road and weather conditions are good.
The maximum safe speed in all road and weather conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed when road and weather conditions are good.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the limit for safety. When conditions are poor, slow down.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of a crosswalk ahead. Watch for pedestrians and let them cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. Making a right turn here is unsafe and illegal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction traffic flows on a one-way street. You must drive in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming. Get ready to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery and dangerous. This sign warns you to slow down because wet pavement makes it harder to stop and control your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. Do not turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that another road crosses the highway coming up.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A roundabout is ahead. Enter slowly and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on the upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers of hazards. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and be ready to control your speed to protect your brakes.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs show motorist services. They tell you about rest areas, food, hospitals, and other services ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow diamond warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a side road is coming up. Be ready for traffic entering from the side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow diamond warning signs alert you to road hazards. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to drive safely.

questions.question: What should you do at this red and white sign?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic from both directions before going.
Let traffic on the road you want to enter or cross go first.
Keep a steady speed and check all directions for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let traffic on the road you want to enter or cross go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Let other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians pass first. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means no right turns allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter this road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs always mean stop. You must stop completely and let other traffic and pedestrians pass. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, you must yield the right-of-way. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians cross your path first. Stop if needed before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has three or more curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for traffic and pedestrians to clear before going.

questions.question: When you approach an octagonal sign, you must:
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop, let traffic and pedestrians pass, and go when it is safe.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: A triangle pointing downward is always a yield sign. You must be ready to slow down or stop when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
Road work or maintenance is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road work or maintenance is ahead.
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you to slow down and be very careful because work is happening on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane ends ahead. Drivers in that lane need to merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A highway entrance ramp is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane ends ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that vehicles from another road may merge into your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead is divided. Stay to the right of the center divider or median.

questions.question: This sign warns that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign is placed a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction shown by the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and vehicles with multiple passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disability permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a traffic signal is coming. Be ready for red, yellow, and green lights, and watch for other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming. Get ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is for left turns only. You cannot use it to pass other cars or to drive straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: This sign shows a type of:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions right ahead. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A 35 mph speed zone starts after the curve.
Drive at least 35 mph around the curve.
Drive 35 mph or slower around the curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive 35 mph or slower around the curve.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions right ahead. Speed advisory signs show the safe speed for the hazard ahead.
